scientific_integrity: All formulas are supported by a stated proof; finite tests corroborate selected cases but do not constitute infinite verification. No independent audit or external mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Nonunital free anti-associative algebras over finite fields of odd characteristic only; the rank condensation assumes a fixed field order and n tends to infinity. Embedded retractions and images are counted, not abstract isomorphism classes. Publication priority is provisional pending further literature comparison, particularly general operadic free-object retraction methods.
title: Cubic-rank condensation for retractions of free anti-associative algebras
